 583| def generate_read_in_summary(
 584|     *,
 585|     db_session,
 586|     subject: Subject,
 587|     project: Project,
 588|     channel_id: str,
 589|     important_reaction: str,
 590|     participant_email: str = "",
 591| ) -> ReadInSummaryResponse:
 592|     """
 593|     Generate a read-in summary for a subject.
 594| 
 595|     Args:
 596|         subject (Subject): The subject object for which the read-in summary is being generated.
 597|         project (Project): The project context.
 598|         channel_id (str): The channel ID to get conversation from.
 599|         important_reaction (str): The reaction to filter important messages.
 600|         participant_email (str): The email of the participant for whom the summary was generated.
 601| 
 602|     Returns:
 603|         ReadInSummaryResponse: A structured response containing the read-in summary or error message.
 604|     """
 605|     subject_type = subject.type
 606| 
 607|     # Check for recent summary event
 608|     if subject_type == IncidentSubjects.incident:
 609|         recent_event = event_service.get_recent_summary_event(
 610|             db_session, incident_id=subject.id, max_age_seconds=READ_IN_SUMMARY_CACHE_DURATION
 611|         )
 612|     else:
 613|         recent_event = event_service.get_recent_summary_event(
 614|             db_session, case_id=subject.id, max_age_seconds=READ_IN_SUMMARY_CACHE_DURATION
 615|         )
 616| 
 617|     if recent_event and recent_event.details:
 618|         try:
 619|             summary = ReadInSummary(**recent_event.details)
 620|             return ReadInSummaryResponse(summary=summary)
 621|         except Exception as e:
 622|             log.warning(
 623|                 f"Failed to parse cached summary from event {recent_event.id}: {e}. Generating new summary."
 624|             )
 625| 
 626|     # Don't generate if no enabled ai plugin or storage plugin
 627|     genai_plugin = plugin_service.get_active_instance(
 628|         db_session=db_session, plugin_type="artificial-intelligence", project_id=project.id
 629|     )
 630|     if not genai_plugin:
 631|         message = f"Read-in summary not generated for {subject.name}. No artificial-intelligence plugin enabled."
 632|         log.warning(message)

The decision is made in `generate_read_in_summary`, which reuses an earlier read-in summary if one is recent enough and otherwise generates a new one. A reused briefing can be up to 120 seconds old (`READ_IN_SUMMARY_CACHE_DURATION = 120  # 2 minutes` in `src/dispatch/ai/constants.py`). The lookup is `get_recent_summary_event` in `src/dispatch/event/service.py`, which returns the newest matching AI summary event whose `started_at` falls inside that window. If it finds one with parseable details, the cached summary is returned. Otherwise a new summary is generated.

The function's own default `max_age_seconds` is 300 seconds, but the caller always passes the 120-second constant, so 120 seconds is the effective limit. I made no code changes.
